def rdread(f):
    m=Chem.MolFromMolFile(f,removeHs=False)
    conf=m.GetConformer()

def rot_align(a,b):
    """rotation matrix taking unit vec a to unit vec b"""
    a=a/np.linalg.norm(a); b=b/np.linalg.norm(b)
    v=np.cross(a,b); c=a@b
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-8:
        if c>0: return np.eye(3)
        # 180 deg
        axis=np.array([1,0,0.]) if abs(a[0])<0.9 else np.array([0,1,0.])
        axis=axis-a*(axis@a); axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
        return 2*np.outer(axis,axis)-np.eye(3)
    s=np.linalg.norm(v); vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*((1-c)/s**2)

def place(sym,xyz,donor_idx,lp_dir,target_pos,u):

    x=(xyz-xyz[donor_idx])@R.T
    return x+target_pos
